hooks.command: cmd="$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT"; if echo "$cmd" | grep -qiE '(drop[[:space:]]+database|drop[[:space:]]+table|truncate[[:space:]]+table)'; then echo "WARNING: BLOCKED - destructive database operation detected (DROP/TRUNCATE)."; exit 2; fi; if echo "$cmd" | grep -qE 'rm[[:space:]]+(-[a-z]*f[a-z]*[[:space:]]+)?(/|\./)'; then echo "WARNING: BLOCKED - destructive file deletion detected (rm -rf)."; exit 2; fi; if echo "$cmd" | grep -qE 'git[[:space:]]+push.*--no-verify'; then echo "WARNING: BLOCKED - --no-verify bypasses quality gates. Fix the underlying issue instead."; exit 2; fi

f=$(printf '%s' "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | sed -n 's/.*"file_path"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p'); [ -z "$f" ] && exit 0; if echo "$f" | grep -qE 'tests/.*InMemory.*Test\.php$'; then echo "WARNING: BLOCKED - InMemory repositories are test doubles and must NEVER be tested."; exit 2; fi; if echo "$f" | grep -qE '/app/[A-Z].*/.*\.php$'; then echo "WARNING: BLOCKED - domain PHP must not live in app/ - use modules/ instead."; exit 2; fi
if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qE '(dd\(|dump\(|var_dump\()'; then echo 'WARNING: Debug statement detected. Remove dd()/dump()/var_dump() before committing.'; fi
echo 'Commit created. Run tests before pushing: ./vendor/bin/phpunit'

f=$(printf '%s' "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | sed -n 's/.*"file_path"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p'); case "$f" in */vendor/*) ;; *.php) ./vendor/bin/pint --test "$f" 2>&1 | tail -5 && ./vendor/bin/phpstan analyse --no-progress --memory-limit=2G "$f" 2>&1 | tail -10 || echo "[hook] Pint/PHPStan issues on $f - fix before commit" ;; esac

f=$(printf '%s' "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | sed -n 's/.*"file_path"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p'); case "$f" in */resources/frontend/src/lib/i18n/*.ts) repo="${f%%/resources/frontend/*}"; node "$repo/.claude/skills/i18n-parity/check.mjs" || echo "[hook] i18n parity mismatch - run node .claude/skills/i18n-parity/check.mjs before PR" ;; esac

changes=$(git status --porcelain 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$changes" ]; then count=$(echo "$changes" | wc -l | tr -d ' '); echo "WARNING: $count uncommitted file(s) detected - consider committing before stopping."; echo "$changes" | head -5; if [ "$count" -gt 5 ]; then echo "  ... and $((count - 5)) more"; fi; fi; exit 0
